title: Does a raw NO_WINTER flag beat a roster that wants the species in Winter? CTRL set to Winter; GROUNDHOG (natural NO_WINTER) at FREQUENCY 100 and stock 500 -- what the tool does when it makes a species active in Winter -- every other land species at 1. Control: the same with NO_WINTER cleared.
fork: the flag wins (no groundhog in winter) or the tool's stock/frequency wins

predictions.model: DF checks NO_<season> at the pick (T2: NO_SPRING)
predictions.expects: natural arm 0 groundhog waves; cleared arm groundhog most waves

kill_criterion: groundhog waves in the natural arm within 2 of the cleared arm
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: winter_natural
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')
df.global.cur_year_tick=319200; df.global.cur_season=3; df.global.cur_season_tick=1680; print(('eco: season %d year tick %d'):format(df.global.cur_season, df.global.cur_year_tick))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local want={}; for _,t in ipairs({'GROUNDHOG'}) do want[t]=true end; local n=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if cr and want[cr.creature_id] and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) then pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false; n=n+1 end end; print(('eco: %d entries stocked at 500'):format(n))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local land={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) and df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' then land[pop.race]=true end end; local n,o=0,0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='GROUNDHOG' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif land[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; print(('eco: %d named species set, %d other land species at frequency 1'):format(n,o))

for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='GROUNDHOG' then print(('eco: GROUNDHOG NO_WINTER=%s season=%d'):format(tostring(cr.caste[0].flags.NO_WINTER), df.global.cur_season)) end end

arms.name: winter_cleared
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')
df.global.cur_year_tick=319200; df.global.cur_season=3; df.global.cur_season_tick=1680; print(('eco: season %d year tick %d'):format(df.global.cur_season, df.global.cur_year_tick))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local want={}; for _,t in ipairs({'GROUNDHOG'}) do want[t]=true end; local n=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if cr and want[cr.creature_id] and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) then pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false; n=n+1 end end; print(('eco: %d entries stocked at 500'):format(n))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local land={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) and df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' then land[pop.race]=true end end; local n,o=0,0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='GROUNDHOG' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif land[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; print(('eco: %d named species set, %d other land species at frequency 1'):format(n,o))

for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='GROUNDHOG' then for _,k in ipairs(cr.caste) do k.flags.NO_WINTER=false end; print('eco: GROUNDHOG NO_WINTER cleared') end end

for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='GROUNDHOG' then print(('eco: GROUNDHOG NO_WINTER=%s season=%d'):format(tostring(cr.caste[0].flags.NO_WINTER), df.global.cur_season)) end end
